insight.headline: Cart mutations reject unconfirmed writes in POS UI extensions 2026-10
insight.what_changed: In POS UI extensions API version 2026-10, Cart API mutations reject when Shopify POS doesn't confirm that the cart changed. In earlier versions these mutations resolve whether or not POS applied the write. This is a breaking change for apps that adopt 2026-10, and those apps need to handle a rejected promise on every cart mutation they call. Apps on 2026-07 and earlier are unaffected. What changed…
